title: Gambas al Ajillo
steps: Heat garlic oil and sliced garlic over high heat until the garlic is golden brown.
Add shrimp, kosher salt and red pepper flakes. Cook until the shrimp are cooked through without overcooking, about 1 minute.
Deglaze with brandy and cook off the alcohol. Add parsley and sauté to coat the shrimp. Cook the remaining pan liquid until emulsified and pour it over the shrimp.
Meanwhile, grill the sliced bread until grill marks form. Serve with the shrimp.
